stocks.name: 翻訳センター
stocks.businessSummary: Honyaku Center Inc. provides translation services in Japan and internationally. The company offers translation for patent documents comprising application-related, court-related, and others; and medical documents, including basic research/non-clinical development, clinical development, regulatory submission, and post-marketing. It also provides financial and legal translations comprising finance, legal, disclosure and related documents, and corporate and other documents; and translation services for IT related documents and manuals documents. In addition, the company offers translation of industrial documents, such as R&D, planning, and design documents; production, quality assurance, implementation, and maintenance service documents; sales and marketing documents; and non-manufacturing industry related documents. Further, it provides medical writing, grammar check, transcription, staffing, multilingual contact center, interpreting, foreign patent application services; proofreading and back translation, and foreign patent application services, as well as services related to computer games, apps, and Websites; and prepares drawings. Additionally, the company offers translation services for VISA application documents required to apply for marriage, work, residency, study abroad, and other visas; and DTP, printing, document, and e-book translation related services, as well as pamphlets and catalogues, press releases and newsletters, and presentation documents. The company serves clients in a range of industries, such as auto, mechanical, electronics, pharma, patent, law, finance, R&D, education, and other fields. Honyaku Center Inc. was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

stocks.name: ディップ
stocks.businessSummary: DIP Corporation engages in the human resources service business in Japan and the United States. The company offers dip AI, a dialogue-based part-time job search service; Baitoru talk, a communication app for store managers and part-time employees; Baitoru, a portal website for part time employees; Spot Baitoru, a job matching service that connects people who want to work in their spare time with establishments looking for workers; Baitoru NEXT, a job information website for those who are looking to work as regular or contract employees; Baitoru PRO, a job information site for specialized jobs; Hatarako net, a portal website connecting companies with those seeking regular, dispatched or part-time employment; Nurse de Hatarako, a job agency website for nurses; and Kaigo de Hatarako, a job agency website for care worker. It also provides Interview KOBOT, which handles accepting applications, and setting interview dates and times on behalf of the hiring manager; Personnel Administration KOBOT, a digital labor force that automates routine task; Corporate Recruiting Page KOBOT, a staff recruitment page for each client; HR KOBOT for Application Support; HR KOBOT which provides application support; Patronage KOBOT, a digital membership card service to attract regular customers with LINE Mini Apps; MEO KOBOT, a service to rank higher in map searches and boost customer acquisition; Baitoru magazine, an information platform that for finding part-time jobs and changing careers; Hatarako magazine, an information source for finding new working styles; AINOW, an AI-specialized media; dip Research Institute; and dip people. DIP Corporation was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

stocks.name: ニッピ
stocks.businessSummary: Nippi,Incorporated, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells collagen casing and gelatin products in Japan, Thailand, rest of Asia, North America, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Collagen Casing Business, Gelatin-Related Business, Cosmetics Related Business, Leather-Related Business, Rental and Real Estate Business, and Food and Other Businesses segments. The company offers collagen casings for use in various fields, including sausages, other food, medicine and medical care, and cosmetics; gelatin products, which is used in food, pharmaceuticals, and photo films; collagen peptides for the food, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic industries; leather products for shoes, bags, automobiles, and other leather-related products; and collagen-based cosmetics, skin and health care, and functional food products. It also provides functional polymers comprising Nippi Linker cross-linked polyvinyl chloride (PVC) films and sheets, and cross-linked PVC compounds for electric wires and cables; and Nippi V foam PVC quilting cloth and foam products. In addition, the company offers pet supplements, and test regents and kits for animals; and life science products, such as low endotoxin gelatin products, recombinant human laminin protein for iPS cell culture substrates, lab equipment and supplies, and substrates and reagents for research. Further, it engages in the development of urban renewal projects; leasing land, buildings, and equipment; and import and sale of Italian food ingredients, organic grains, fertilizers, other chemical products, linkers, and BSE testing. The company was formerly known as The Japan Leather Mfg. Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippi,Incorporated in February 1974. The company was incorporated in 1907 and is headquartered in Adachi, Japan.
